newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel Corp EPS raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel Corp EPS raised.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst Erika Klauer said she raised her 1997 earnings per share view on Intel Corp to $6.00 from $5.70 "due to our expectation that Intel is likely to keep capital spending flat in 1997, possibly even down from 1996, thereby slowing the growth of depreciation dramatically.
-- "Since depriciation is reflected in the cost of goods sold line, the slowing in depreciation growth will positively impact gross margins beyond our initial projections," she said.
